abi: No new unsafe/FFI/dependency; existing C oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Eight new portable tests and prior shared/native changes still need pinned native checks; previous approval quota issue remains.

limitations: Trusted Evidence is explicit caller data, not authorization minted by controller; actual parent/session/Stop/clock provider integration not implemented.
Generic IO must be nonblocking/owned; allocator, thread spawn and completed join have no hard time bound.
Idle WouldBlock has no transaction deadline; first header byte PRE-time anchors strict budget. No prefix/job/ack renewals.
Close drops owned copies but original inherited FDs remain until exit; running job retained and reaped, never preempted or restarted. Drop may detach unreaped thread.
Actual activate may precede post-check failure; no rollback/new ack. Written ack bytes cannot be retracted, parent must post-read check independently.
Owned pipe test uses pure Engine and simulated Evidence, not native input/provider/session readiness proof.
Real main/host/Windows CaptureSession loop, watcher and reload CLI remain unconnected.
No new input/output device, VT, suspend, global Hook/SendInput or driver actions.
Full original cross-platform objective remains unfinished.
